value.text: On Kristallnacht—the Night of Broken Glass—in November 1938, Nazi brownshirts torched synagogues, vandalized Jewish homes and schools and businesses, killed approximately one hundred Jews, and hauled many others to concentration camps.

...As soon as the course of events tonight permits the use of the appointed officials for this purpose, as many Jews are to be seized, especially wealthy ones, in all regions as can be accomodated in the prisons at hand. Moreover, only healthy, male Jews of not too great an age are to be seized. After carrying out the seizure, negotiations are to be taken up at once with the proper concentration camps for the quickest accomodation of the Jews. Signed: Heydrich, SS Gruppenfuehrer
